Best I was able in those papers I wrote for school I steered clear of punctuation; the only punctuation I availed myself of was the capital letter at the beginning of a sentence, the period at its conclusion. Semicolons, colons, dashes, parentheses, and the rest of punctuation was, in a cliché of the day, all Greek to me. The post Punctuation Matters appeared first on .
